_doc: Master registry of PoE1 crafting mechanics. 'status' is one of: implemented_verified, implemented_partially_verified, experimental, discovered_not_implemented, unsupported, outdated, removed, unknown. Nothing is 'implemented_verified' until it has passed reference cases cross-checked against an independent tool or in-game test (see TESTING.md). 'verified_for_patch' is the patch whose rules this registry was last reviewed against; if the imported game data is a newer major.minor patch, the app shows a warning and flags all recommendations.

mechanics.name: Mod pools and spawn weights (which mods can roll, tiers, item-level gates, weights)
mechanics.notes: Cross-checked 2026-11-26 against Craft of Exile's data (scripts/compare_craftofexile.py): 10 bases x item level 30/68/86 = 30 reference cases; 29 identical tier by tier (presence, required level, weight). Only difference: wand local mana leech (CoE 1000, ours 500 = spawn 1000 x the data's 50% wand generation weight, which CoE applies to the matching life-leech mod but not to mana leech). CoE also rounds 12.5 weights down to 12 (<0.01% effect). Influence pools not yet cross-checked. Extended 2026-11-26 to influence pools: 9 bases x 6 influences; 53/54 identical, the one difference (Hunter wand mod, CoE 200 vs ours 100) is the same CoE wand generation-weight quirk. Total 62/64 cases identical at item level 86.

mechanics.name: Multi-step recipes (repeat until, check, restart/goto)
mechanics.notes: engine/recipe.py (2026-11-26). Runs any sequence of supported actions with costs; used by the planner's lock route. Tested on fixed cases; outcomes inherit each action's status.

mechanics.name: Orb of Transmutation
mechanics.notes: 1 vs 2 mod split is a placeholder assumption (assumptions.json: magic_mod_count).

mechanics.name: Orb of Alteration
mechanics.notes: Same 1/2 mod placeholder as Transmutation.

mechanics.name: Orb of Alchemy
mechanics.notes: Mod count 4/5/6 = 8:3:1 (community-measured).

mechanics.name: Chaos Orb
mechanics.notes: Mod count 4/5/6 = 8:3:1 (community-measured). Interaction with prefix/suffix lock modelled as: locked side kept, total count drawn from the same distribution.

mechanics.name: Orb of Annulment
mechanics.notes: Uniform over removable explicit mods; fractured and metamod-locked mods are protected.

mechanics.name: Orb of Scouring
mechanics.notes: Rarity after scouring an item that keeps fractured mods is UNVERIFIED (engine keeps rarity).

mechanics.name: Divine Orb
mechanics.notes: Rerolls explicit values uniformly within each stat range; fractured values kept.

mechanics.name: Blessed Orb
mechanics.notes: Implicit values are not modelled yet.

mechanics.name: Orb of Chance
mechanics.notes: 3.30: much higher unique chance, much rarer, no longer sold by vendors; bench options that cost Chance now cost Alteration (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)).

mechanics.name: Vaal Orb / corruption
mechanics.notes: Corrupted items are rejected by every action (correct), but corruption outcomes are not modelled.

mechanics.name: Double corruption (Vaal temple / Altar)
mechanics.notes: 3.30: Altar of Corruption and Lapidary Lens corrupt an equipment item or gem a second time ('Twice Corrupted'); the Lens can destroy the item; the Altar's corrupted-influence outcome now destroys the item (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). Outcome odds not published.

mechanics.name: Essences (Whispering to Deafening)
mechanics.notes: Forced mod + rare reforge from game data. 3.30: new Essence of Trickery; Weeping/Wailing essences no longer spawn on monsters in yellow/red maps (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). 'Shrieking/Deafening can reforge rares' still to be confirmed in game. Essences ignore prefix/suffix locks (only fractured mods stay), per Maxroll crafting resources (read 2026-11-26).

mechanics.name: Fossils + Resonators
mechanics.notes: Weight multipliers by mod tag. Not yet modelled: added/forced mods (Glyphic, Tangled...), mirrored, sockets, quality, corrupted essence chance, 'lucky' rolls. Fossils ignore prefix/suffix locks (only fractured mods stay), per Maxroll crafting resources (read 2026-11-26).

mechanics.name: Crafting bench: add modifier
mechanics.notes: Validated against bench options present in the imported game data.

mechanics.name: Can have up to 3 Crafted Modifiers
mechanics.notes: Cost 2 Divine (3.30 game data).

mechanics.name: Cannot roll Attack Modifiers
mechanics.notes: Blocks mods carrying the 'attack' tag. 3.30: no longer stops Annulment-type removal of attack mods (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)); the engine never protected them, so it already matches. Cost 1 Divine (game data).

mechanics.name: Cannot roll Caster Modifiers
mechanics.notes: Blocks mods carrying the 'caster' tag. 3.30: no longer stops Annulment-type removal of caster mods (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)); engine already matches. Cost 1 Divine (game data).

mechanics.name: Prefix/Suffix Modifiers cannot be changed
mechanics.notes: 3.30: crafting-bench options in the game data (StrMaster/DexMaster...CannotChangePrefixes/Suffixes). Cost by item type: weapons 4 Divine + 1 Sacred, armour/quivers 4 Divine + 4 Blessed, jewellery 4 Divine + 8 Exalted; recipe drops in Nightmare Maps. Effect modelled; costs match patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26) and data. Planner route 'Lock prefixes/suffixes, scour, exalt' (multi-step recipe): Chaos for one side, bench lock, Scour (removes the other side and the lock), Exalted Orbs; each try consumes a lock.

mechanics.name: 1 / 2 Prefix (Suffix) Modifier(s) cannot be changed
mechanics.notes: NEW bench crafts in 3.30: '1 Prefix/Suffix Modifier cannot be changed' (1 Divine), '2 ... cannot be changed' (2 Divine); present in the game data with these costs (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). Engine still refuses such items. Open question: which mod(s) a partial lock protects (chosen? random?) must be sourced before implementing.

mechanics.name: Harvest (Horticrafting) crafts
mechanics.notes: IMPLEMENTED (experimental, 2026-11-26): tag reforges (harvest_reforge: one mod with the tag is rolled first, then the item is filled like a Chaos Orb) and add-tagged/remove-random (harvest_add_remove); costs from knowledge/harvest_crafts.json. Rolling order is the common understanding, not a published rule. Also implemented: 'more likely the same modifier types' (harvest_reforge_same, using the x90 multiplier and never-fewer-mods rule from an outdated 2020 report: assumptions.json) and fire/cold/lightning resistance or damage swaps to the same tier number (harvest_swap; 'similar tier' interpreted as same tier number). NOT yet: 'less likely' (unquantified), influence reforges, enchants. 3.30: Harvest is Sacred Flora inside maps (no subarea); lifeforce Wild/Vivid/Primal (+Sacred, + Crystallised Rancour for some). CONFLICT: 'more likely' strength is x90 per Craft of Exile (second-hand, 2020) vs '10x' per Maxroll (unsourced); engine uses x90 flagged as outdated.

mechanics.name: Bestiary / beastcrafting
mechanics.notes: IMPLEMENTED (experimental, 2026-11-26): Farric Lynx Alpha (add a suffix, remove a random prefix) and Farric Wolf Alpha (the reverse), rare items only; beast prices from poe.ninja (Beast category). Not yet: metamod beast, imprints, influence beasts. 3.30: yellow beasts no longer needed or captured; flask-mod recipes need a red beast (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). Equipment recipes (poedb.tw/us/Bestiary_Recipe (78 recipes, read 2026-11-26; page states no patch version)): add suffix + remove random prefix (Farric Lynx Alpha) and the reverse (Farric Wolf Alpha), rare only; add a crafted meta-modifier to a non-unique item (Wild Bristle Matron); imprint of a magic item (Craicic Croaker); add a mod to Shaper/Elder/conqueror items; max links/sockets; aspects; flask suffixes. Version of the recipe list unconfirmed.

mechanics.name: Fracturing Orb
mechanics.notes: IMPLEMENTED (experimental, 2026-11-26): Fracturing Orb fractures a random modifier on a rare item with at least 4 modifiers; not usable on influenced or already fractured items (poedb.tw/us/Fracturing_Orb, current). Crafted mods are excluded (assumption fracture_excludes_crafted, unverified). Fractured mods are protected from all removal. Fractured mods ARE modelled (protected) when present on a parsed item. 3.30: Tier-5 magic drops can be fractured; fractured drops removed from many sources (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). Fracturing Orb not mentioned in the notes; not implemented.

mechanics.name: Recombinators
mechanics.notes: Exists in 3.30 (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)): result takes the item level of the selected input base; cannot be used on corrupted items; with 1-3 total prefixes or suffixes the result gets fewer on average; mods illegal on the new base are ignored. Exact outcome probabilities are not published. Community odds exist but DISAGREE: aoeah 3.29 guide ('Butsicles' research'): pool 1: 59/41, 2: 67/33, 3: 40/50/10, 4: 10/60/30, 5: 43/57, 6: 30/70; poedb: 66.6/33.3, 66.6/33.3, 30/50/20, 10/55/35, 50/50, 30/70. 3.30 changed pools of 1-3 again. Exclusive mods: at most one survives. See docs/RESOURCES.md.

mechanics.name: Conqueror exalts / Awakener's Orb / Orb of Dominance / Maven's Orb
mechanics.notes: IMPLEMENTED (experimental, 2026-11-27): Shaper's/Elder's/Crusader's/Hunter's/Redeemer's/Warlord's Exalted Orb give an uninfluenced rare the influence and add one mod from that influence's own pool (pools verified against Craft of Exile). NOT yet: Awakener's Orb (two items), Orb of Dominance / elevated mods, Maven's Orb. Influence tags already widen the mod pool correctly; the currencies that add influence are not modelled. Rules (Maxroll, Craft of Exile basics): conqueror exalts add an influenced mod to uninfluenced items; Awakener's Orb keeps up to one influenced mod from each item and rerolls the rest like a Chaos Orb; Orb of Dominance removes one influenced mod and upgrades another ('50/50'). Influence pools themselves are verified against Craft of Exile.

mechanics.name: Eldritch implicits, Ichors, Embers, Eldritch Chaos/Exalt/Annul
mechanics.notes: IMPLEMENTED (experimental, 2026-11-27): Lesser-Exceptional Eldritch Embers/Ichors set the Exarch/Eater implicit (assumption eldritch_currency_tier: exactly the currency's tier, weighted by spawn weight); the higher tier is dominant (a tie is refused, undocumented); Eldritch Exalted Orb adds and Eldritch Annulment removes a prefix (Exarch dominant) or suffix (Eater dominant); the item parser recognises Eldritch implicits on pasted items. NOT yet: Eldritch Chaos Orb (how many mods it rerolls is undocumented), Orb of Conflict (odds partly documented), implicits as planner targets. Searing Exarch / Eater of Worlds implicit mods are in the 3.30 game data (generation types searing_exarch_implicit / eater_of_worlds_implicit). 3.30 notes change only altar drop rewards (Threads), not the crafting itself. Rules (Maxroll crafting resources and Eldritch guide, read 2026-11-26): six tiers Lesser..Perfect; Embers (Exarch) and Ichors (Eater) reach Exceptional; Orb of Conflict upgrades one implicit and downgrades the other (50/50 at equal tiers, lower tier more likely to upgrade); dominance decides whether Eldritch Chaos/Exalted/Annulment act on prefixes (Exarch) or suffixes (Eater); not on Shaper/Elder/conqueror items. Tier weights are in the Craft of Exile data and RePoE.

mechanics.name: Veiled mods and unveiling
mechanics.notes: 3.30: Veiled Chaos/Exalted Orbs moved to the League currency section; veiled items no longer come from non-Betrayal content (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). A third-party guide reports that since 3.30.0b hotfix 4 Veiled Chaos Orbs work on items with a veiled mod (unverified). Unveil mods exist in the game data (domain 'unveiled'). Aisling (Betrayal) not mentioned in the 3.30 notes.

mechanics.name: Cluster jewel crafting
mechanics.notes: Cluster mods depend on enchant + passive count, not modelled yet.

mechanics.name: Regular / abyss jewel crafting
mechanics.notes: Pool and 2+2 affix limit modelled; rare jewel mod count is a placeholder.

mechanics.name: Flask crafting (magic)
mechanics.notes: Transmute/alt/aug pool modelled. Flask enchantments (Enkindling/Instilling), tinctures not modelled.

mechanics.name: Map crafting
mechanics.notes: Out of scope until item crafting is solid.

mechanics.name: 3.30 Covens of Umbra: Gwennen coin-flip crafting
mechanics.notes: Gwennen offers three sets of two crafting options for a rare item; a coin flip applies one option of the chosen set; paid with Broken Circle Artifacts (one Astragali per item) (patch notes 3.30.0 (patchbot.io mirror of the official notes, read 2026-11-26)). No option list, odds or costs published (poedb has no page for it as of 2026-11-26). Cannot be modelled until data exists.

mechanics.name: Scarabs (replaced by Threads in 3.30)
mechanics.notes: Not a crafting mechanic; listed so old strategies relying on scarab-driven farming are flagged.
